ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Of Libcurl.DLL Via GUP.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "libcurl.dll" by the "gup.exe" process from an uncommon location Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\gup\\\.exe$") AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\libcurl\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\Notepad\\+\\+\\\\updater\\\\GUP\\\.exe$"))
